title: Low-code vs custom: 2026 benchmarks
takeaways: 98% of tech leaders saved development time with low-code (App Builder)
62% cut development costs; 67% by up to 30%
35% of teams replaced a SaaS tool with a custom build (Retool)
60% of builders shipped software outside IT oversight
India low-code market: $2,896.8 million by 2030 (Grand View)
source_note: Sources: App Builder 2025; Retool 2026; Gartner; Grand View Research
